text:
elaine (growth): quick heads up — need final copy + FAQ updates for the pricing bundle calculator experiment. launch post, benchmark narrative, and webinar CTA hang on this. can we sync?
raj (product): sure. which calculator variant are we shipping? single-bundle vs tiered-bundle?
elaine (growth): variant B (single bundled plan with optional committed discount). spreadsheet -> https://tiny.redwood/bundle-calc-v2
zoe (content): saw it. copy feels too nerdy for homepage. suggest: 1) plain-language headline 2) micro-examples (startup / midmarket / enterprise) 3) one-sentence FAQ: "How do you save with commitment?"
michael (analytics): to add — we should show an example row for 10k tokens/min session and 100k monthly tokens. baseline CTR for calculator hit is 3.2%. target lift 15%.
sam (ops): inbound lead routing: if calc leads include "enterprise interest" checkbox, route to CS queue; else self-serve nurture. also add hidden utm param so we can map funnel variants.
zoe (content): proposed headline: "One predictable bill. Flexible performance." microcopy for example: "Startup: 50k tokens/mo — $X (no commit) or $Y (12mo)"
raj (product): can we include a tiny explainer about quantization/latency tradeoffs? might be too technical for marketing. maybe link to docs instead.
elaine (growth): agree. link to docs is enough. we need FAQ entries updated: - what is a token? - how does dedicated capacity affect price? - can I switch tiers mid-cycle?
kate (cs): for "switch mid-cycle" answer: prorate credits and honor committed rate for remainder. also add note about contacting CS for migrations.
marc-bot: deploy-notice: pricing-calculator-preview deployed to staging at 1709876600
zoe (content): small content ask — change tier name suggestions: avoid numeric-sounding names. propose: "Starter / Team / Scale" instead of Core/Pro/Enterprise. feels friendlier.
michael (analytics): agree on names, but include internal mapping table to existing segments for reporting.
elaine (growth): copy deadline = EOD tomorrow. webinar promotion flow: show calculator in a 10-min demo clip and CTA to sign up for the pricing deep-dive. raj can you add a short GIF of calc flow?
raj (product): yep, will record a 20s clip. will attach by EOD.
sam (ops): routing reminder: lead created from calculator = tag "calc_v2" + variant param. then: if ARR_estimate >= 100k -> route to enterprise queue. else -> growth nurture.
zoe (content): FAQ draft for "how is price calculated?": "Price = base plan + usage fee. example formula:```
price = base_monthly + (tokens_used / 1000) * unit_price
```where unit_price depends on commit level and model family."
kate (cs): add line: "We’ll help you estimate costs — request a tailored quote for high volume."
elaine (growth): final checklist: 1) content copy (zoe) 2) calc UI labels (raj) 3) routing hooks (sam) 4) analytics events + mapping (michael) 5) FAQ snippets (kate) 6) staging review (everyone)
zoe (content): taking copy. will ping once draft is in doc. :white_check_mark:
raj (product): will update UI labels and attach GIF.
michael (analytics): will add event spec + dashboard slices.
sam (ops): will add routing config to the runbook and create test leads.
kate (cs): happy to review FAQ phrasing with legal if needed.
elaine (growth): thanks all. quick sync tomorrow 9:30a PT to finalize before send. :rocket:
